svg.title: Timeline of the CT 2.0.0 live acceptance capture
svg.desc: Three lanes over the 15-minute capture: heartbeats every 10 s, snapshot ends every 60 s labelled with the number of cues they published, and track_cue datagrams sized by opportunity count.
svg.text: What arrived, and when: CT 2.0.0 live capture, 2026-09-26 from 15:23 UTC
Numbers above snapshot marks = published_track_count, each equal to the track_cue messages received for that snapshot.
Dot size in the track_cue lane grows with the number of opportunities (0 to 8).
